arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Credit' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 50000
arguments.explanation: Counts the transactions over $500 made with credit cards.
assumptions: Same question as before: transactions over $500, which is strictly more than 50000 cents, this time on cards with card_type 'Credit'.
All transactions are counted, labelled or not, and no date filter is applied.
